scope: Independent static helper/test review and deterministic test execution including real isolated CLI consumers. Consumption-only replay, not measurement acceptance, strict native certification, lifecycle proof or token acquisition regeneration. No model calls or production/source edits.

identified_bug_and_resolution.initial_bug: Empty or omitted case sets could return a passing replay without consuming every registered case.
identified_bug_and_resolution.resolution: Current helper binds fixture bytes to manifest and requires exact fixture case coverage, rejecting empty/omitted sets in tests.

tests.positive: Exact final-state restoration runs real runcheck, events validate/read/verify and mixed-ledger summary, retaining OPEN-1 refusal and absent incomplete summary.

source_checks: Exact ledger_bytes and JSONL reconstructed by ordered JSON.stringify plus trailing newline must equal captured last-append hashes.
Initial event prefix, appended suffix and captured event-read array are bound before consumers.
Original run IDs, owner timestamps, event timestamps, ledger paths inside bytes and heartbeat bytes are preserved.
Consumers use fresh isolated roots, clean environment and explicit paths. No open/close/append/transcript recreation occurs.
Only parsed runcheck.stdout.run_dir is relocated; all other parsed runcheck fields, exit/stderr/error match. Other consumer stdout is exact.
Summary uses fixed V2 facts/records and dependency-injected production handler; output and persisted summary compare exactly, with no clock stripping or bucket reordering.
Source snapshot files, helper, reporting shim, fixture and dependency are hash-guarded through completion; pinned runtime artifacts are rechecked.
Restored ledger/events/heartbeat must remain unchanged after all consumers, and temporary roots are removed.

prior_record_version_distinction.requirement: Fresh final replay output must bind the current reviewed helper version; older replay remains historical.

external_mandatory_qualification_gates: Arm gate must require runtime root/commit, helper/fixture/dependency hashes and sample provenance equal the frozen plan.
Arm gate must separately require raw grade, strict native and independent manual success and bind exact replay inputs/results.
Replay success must never qualify or rescore the held old V1 measurement.
This helper can be used diagnostically on a held capture; status pass states only that the recorded final-state consumers reproduce.
